documents.raw_transcript:
Why Digital Forensics Matters Today

Every phone we carry quietly records where we go, who we talk
to, and what we search for. When a crime is committed, this
trail of data often becomes the strongest evidence available.

Investigators extract this data using specialized tools that
pull messages, call logs, photos, and app data off a seized
device without altering the original evidence.

The real challenge is not collecting the data but making sense

of it quickly. A single extraction can contain thousands of
messages and files, far more than any human can review by hand
in time.
